title: Zustellungswiederholung und Totmannschaltung
description: As an operator, I want failed alert deliveries to be retried and finally surfaced, so that no warning is silently lost.

acceptance_criteria.given: the mail server is temporarily unreachable and a version becomes FLAGGED
acceptance_criteria.when: the notification worker retries the delivery
acceptance_criteria.then: the delivery is retried with increasing backoff and the attempt count is recorded
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-027-notification-retry.feature: A failing mail server leads to repeated attempts

acceptance_criteria.given: the mail server stays unreachable and all configured attempts are used up
acceptance_criteria.then: the delivery is moved to the dead letter queue and is visible in the interface
and: the dead letter entry can be retried manually
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-027-notification-retry.feature: After exhausting the attempts the delivery ends in the dead letter queue

acceptance_criteria.given: the mail server is unreachable while a scan completes
acceptance_criteria.then: the version reaches APPROVED or FLAGGED as the scan determined
and: the delivery failure is recorded separately and does not block the scan
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-027-notification-retry.feature: Mail problems never change the scan status
